title: Savings Inspector: suggestion cards, inline diff previews, and reversible apply stream
creator: Riley Park
description: Build a multi-card 'Savings Inspector' UI that surfaces batching and KV-caching recommendations as compact suggestion cards, shows an inline diff preview of config changes and expected token cost delta, and enables a reversible, transactional apply flow with a tamper-proof audit trail. The goal is to help engineering/product teams discover safe, high-confidence cost optimizations and apply them with roll-forward/rewind controls and observability links to runtime telemetry.
background: Current Optimize recommendations are surfaced in a dense list and require manual context-switches to preview and apply. Customers have asked for faster iteration: see, simulate, and apply suggestions without losing the ability to audit and revert. This ticket implements the Console UX components + lightweight orchestration hooks for staged apply and safe rollback. Tied to the Optimize cost model and the runtime's canary apply API.
acceptance_criteria: Suggestion cards list displays top 5 recommendations with summary metrics (estimated monthly savings, confidence, affected routes)
Clicking a card opens an inline diff preview showing exact config changes (JSON) and token-cost delta with baseline/after estimates
User can run a sandbox simulation that executes a dry-run and returns simulated cost and latency impact within 30s
Apply flow supports 'staged canary' and 'full commit' with a single transactional operation visible in the Apply History
Every apply creates an immutable audit record with author, timestamp, diff, runtime cost snapshot link, and a one-click 'Rewind' action to revert within retention window
UI surfaces runtime telemetry links (trace + cost breakdown) for each apply event
E2E tests covering card render, diff preview, dry-run, canary apply, and rewind exist and pass in CI

Automated tests: Cypress for UI flows, unit tests for cost delta calculations, contract tests for audit event schema
Performance: ensure dry-run completes < 30s for 95% of requests on staging
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal beta): Redwood internal teams + SRE (2 weeks)
Phase 2 (pilot customers): 3 pilot customers opt-in; collect observability and revert metrics (3 weeks)

risk_mitigation: Introduce optimistic locking and queueing to prevent conflicting applies
Require explicit confirmation for rewinds and show affected runtime snapshots
Default dry-run before any apply; block full commit if dry-run fails confidence threshold
metrics_and_signals: Adoption: % of customers interacting with suggestion cards
Conversion: % of suggestions leading to canary apply
Economics: realized monthly token savings observed after apply vs estimated
notes: Link runtime snapshots in audit record to the existing runtime cost dashboard for fast incident triage
Consider exposing an advanced CSV export for applied diffs to feed infra IaC tooling
